reports.verdict: Reduced power loss category can be predicted: 91.7% accuracy on unseen data versus 37.4% for always guessing the most common class. Almost all of the signal is in power loss — the learned cut points 1.88 and 3.67 reproduce the label as well as a model using every column (91.9%).
